files.title: File:Persian Gulf (4462609004).jpg
files.author: Mitch Barrie

metadata.ImageDescription: View of the beach at Dubai where I did some body surfing during the midday break from the GiTex tech fair. Unfortunately, I don't know where this is. It's outside the home of the German women we had working with us in the Systronics stand at the show. I'm guessing it's in Jumeira somewhere.
metadata.Artist: Mitch Barrie from Reno, NV, USA

files.provenance_note: Commons transferred this Flickr photo by simonov (Mitch Barrie); FlickreviewR 2 confirmed CC BY-SA 2.0 on 21 February 2018. The original Flickr page opened during this review and confirms November 1993, Dubai beach and uncertainty about Jumeira. Commons records 1 November 1993; exact day is not independently confirmed by the displayed Flickr page.
files.visual_review: Original 640x338 JPEG inspected: sandy beach, sea, swimmers, umbrellas, palm tree. The frame cannot independently establish date, city or exact beach. Image bytes unchanged.
source_limitations: Earlier researcher could not open Flickr; this review did open the original page.
Capture day relies on Commons metadata; Flickr displayed only month/year.
Exact beach unknown. Jumeira is author speculation, not confirmed location.
